tr.title: bear ne demek? (4 anlamı)
tr.metaDesc: bear ne demek? 4 anlamı: ayı, katlanmak, taşımak, akılda tutmak. bear/bore/borne — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: bear ilginç bir kelimedir: hem “ayı” (isim) hem de “katlanmak/taşımak” (fiil) demektir. Bu yüzden çok karıştırılır. Düzensiz: bear → bore → borne.

means.en: We saw a bear in the forest.

tr.quizQ: “I can't bear the noise” ne demek?

en.title: What does bear mean? (4 meanings)
en.metaDesc: What does bear mean? 4 meanings: a bear, to endure, to carry, to bear in mind. bear/bore/borne — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: bear is a tricky word: it means both “a bear” (animal) and “to endure/carry” (verb). That's why it confuses learners. Irregular: bear → bore → borne.

means.en: We saw a bear in the forest.

means.def: to keep in mind (bear in mind)

en.quizQ: What does “I can't bear the noise” mean?

de.title: Was bedeutet bear? (4 Bedeutungen)
de.metaDesc: Was bedeutet bear? 4 Bedeutungen: Bär, ertragen, tragen, im Kopf behalten. bear/bore/borne — LinguaBattle.
de.lede: bear ist ein kniffliges Wort: es bedeutet sowohl „Bär“ (Tier) als auch „ertragen/tragen“ (Verb). Deshalb verwirrt es. Unregelmäßig: bear → bore → borne.

means.en: We saw a bear in the forest.

de.quizQ: Was bedeutet „I can't bear the noise“?
quizA: Ich kann den Lärm nicht ertragen
Ich kann den Lärm nicht tragen

fr.title: Que signifie bear ? (4 sens)
fr.metaDesc: Que signifie bear ? 4 sens : ours, supporter, porter, garder à l'esprit. bear/bore/borne — LinguaBattle.
fr.lede: bear est un mot délicat : il signifie à la fois « ours » (animal) et « supporter/porter » (verbe). C'est pourquoi il déroute. Irrégulier : bear → bore → borne.

means.en: We saw a bear in the forest.

fr.quizQ: Que veut dire « I can't bear the noise » ?
quizA: Je ne supporte pas le bruit
Je ne peux pas porter le bruit

es.lede: bear es una palabra engañosa: significa tanto «oso» (animal) como «soportar/llevar» (verbo). Por eso confunde. Irregular: bear → bore → borne.

hi.title: bear का क्या मतलब है? (4 अर्थ)

ja.title: bearの意味は？（4つの意味）
ja.metaDesc: bearの意味は？4つの意味：クマ、耐える、支える、心に留める。bear/bore/borne — LinguaBattle.
ja.lede: bear は紛らわしい単語：「クマ」（動物）と「耐える／支える」（動詞）の両方の意味がある。だから学習者を混乱させる。不規則：bear → bore → borne。

means.en: We saw a bear in the forest.

means.def: 支える、重さを担う（動詞）
